memory_candidates.content: In the BimodalLogic Lean tree, lakefile.lean declares 'lean_lib FormalSystem where roots := #[`FormalSystem]' -- an import-closure root, NOT a source glob. A newly created .lean file under FormalSystem/ is therefore NEVER compiled by 'lake build' until some module already in the closure imports it (chain: FormalSystem.lean -> FormalSystem/FormalSystem.lean -> Metalogic.lean -> leaf). Consequence for planning: the aggregator import line must land in the SAME phase that creates a new module, not in a later documentation phase. Deferring it produces phases that report green while the new code was never type-checked -- a silent false-green. When planning any new-module work in a roots-based Lake project, treat 'wire the import into the aggregator' as part of file creation, and verify by touching the file and confirming it recompiles.
